nodes.label: Corporate treasury refactor
nodes.rationale: The five migrations are meant to be applied together: the first leaves the old workflow functions broken until the following ones replace them.

nodes.label: Funds reservation on submit
nodes.rationale: Submit moves the total into reserved under a lock so the same money can never be committed twice; cancel, return and reject release it at once.

nodes.label: Separation of duties
nodes.rationale: Creator, verifier and authenticator must be three different people, even for someone holding several roles and for administrators.

nodes.label: graphify knowledge graph rules (abig-finance)
nodes.rationale: Scoped query/path/explain subgraphs are much smaller than GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep output, so the graph is consulted before raw reads.

nodes.label: Migration runner (ops/migrate.mjs)
nodes.rationale: Runs each migration once and stops, changing nothing, if an already-applied file was edited.

nodes.label: Encryption key (APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY)
nodes.rationale: Must be kept in a password vault: without it nobody's two-step verification can be read and everyone must be reset.

nodes.label: Built-in sign-in
nodes.rationale: src/lib/session.ts is the one place that decides who is signed in, so single sign-on can replace it later.

nodes.label: Proxy-only exposure
nodes.rationale: The app trusts the proxy's X-Forwarded-For header for the sign-in log, so the app container must never be published directly.
